Toya Setsuno.name: Toya Setsuno
Toya Setsuno.basicInfo:
Toya Setsuno, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers, and the talker of his trio with Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe. Lean, with chin-length golden hair over one eye, dark circles, a beaked mask and formal clothes.
Speaking Style: Intense and outspoken; takes any sneer at his friends personally.
Combat Role: Disarmer: his Quirk pulls a weapon or tool he can see into his hands.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and sticks closer to Hojo and Tabe.
Toya Setsuno.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His friendship with Hojo and Tabe is real, inside a house that uses them. Motivation: Keeping the friends he found after years of rejection. Connections: Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe, his closest companions; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), their boss. Knowledge: The tunnels, the Trigger trade and his orders. Thread: Whether he is loyal to the house or only to his two friends.
QUIRK: Larceny. Pulls an object he can see out of someone's possession into his hands; things only, and size limits what he can take.
personality: Intense: Throws himself into a fight or an argument.
Outspoken: Tells opponents exactly what he thinks.
Attached: A threat to Hojo or Tabe lands harder than one to himself.
Speaking style: Fervent, quick and blunt.
abilities: Larceny: Takes a visible object from someone into his hands; line of sight and size limit it.
Disarming: Strips a weapon or tool at the key moment; useless against a Quirk.
Fighting style: Works behind Hojo and beside Tabe, stealing gear and openings instead of trading blows.
Toya Setsuno.visualDescription: A lean man with messy, chin-length golden hair falling over one eye, tired eyes ringed with dark circles, and light skin. A dark beaked mask covers his nose and mouth. He wears formal dark clothes: a dark suit jacket, a white shirt and dark trousers. An intense, restless expression, the visible eye sharp and quick.
